Let me use type_designations: ["Aviator"] and description: "Non-automatic weighing instrument, type Aviator (A51 series, A71 series)". Actually I'll include the series in type_designations as they are identifiers mentioned. Hmm.

I think best compromise: type_designations: ["Aviator"], and add description mentioning A51/A71 series. Or model_family with family_name "Aviator" and models A51 series, A71 series? The rule says include model_family ONLY if cert covers >1 model variant AND attributes vary per model. Here characteristics are given as ranges covering both, not per-model. So no model_family. I'll just include type_designations ["Aviator"] and description.
